title: Chapter 416
paragraphs: Chapter 416
Episode 120. Why Hairan? (10)
'How is this possible...? Does this make any sense?'
They couldn't help but be speechless as they looked at the perfectly restored battleship Grenil.
Not only Jin, but the other warriors were also at a loss for words at the terrible fact that the ship had returned.
Even Zipfel had been investing considerable time in repairing the battleship Cozak. Depending on the extent of the damage, repairs could take a few months or even years.
However, it took the leader only about ten seconds to repair Grenil.
It was a hard fact to accept even after seeing it with their own eyes. Can this really be called 'repair'?
Jin and the warriors had no choice but to think so unconsciously.
Fwoosh...!
The battleship Grenil had already formed a new thundercloud, casting an ominous shadow on the ground.
In front of the leader of Kinzelo, iron fragments gathered in his hand, forming a sword.
It was the sword that had once defeated Archmage Susan Rilista and Chukon Toldur in Oterium.
"Stolen the legacy of Leol? That doesn't seem like an appropriate expression. It wasn't yours to begin with."
[Since we were keeping it, it was our property.]
"By that logic, since I have it now, it's mine."
[Hehe, come to think of it, that's true.]
The leader let out a laugh.
They had been encountering the Kinzelo party regularly, but it was the first time they had seen the leader directly since the preliminary round.
Suddenly, the moment he saw him in the second tomb of Temar's record came to mind.
-[What kind of trick is this?]
-[A trick? As a lucky man whose fortune is so immense that my body is crushed by it, I just want to bestow kindness upon the poor orphans.]
-[Get lost. Leave before I kill you too.]
-[Don't be so sharp, and listen to my proposal once. My longtime friend. I have prepared a good future for everyone.]
In the record, the leader had appeared in front of Temar and the Ten Knights who were fighting in the 'tower' in the Black Sea, as well as Murakan.
He had always been curious.
What was the relationship between the leader and Murakan, and what was the good future for everyone that the leader 'proposed' in the second record?
'One thing is certain: the leader has had tremendous power a thousand years ago and now.'
There weren't many beings that could stand in Murakan's way a thousand years ago, and in the present era, the leader was the only one who could use 'teleportation' and instantly restore a battleship.
Moreover, the leader's power was not limited to that.
"In the end, our leader has to use his power..."
Great Warrior Berakt's numerous large and small wounds, which had covered his entire body, were disappearing as if washed away.
Ron and Linpa, instead of pressuring him again, were cautiously assessing the situation.
Silence flowed.
It was the result of a series of shocking scenes following the leader's appearance. They thought they had finally cornered the terrorists, but they were back at square one.
No, the situation was even worse than before, as they couldn't know the extent of the leader's regenerative abilities.

[Leader Kinzelo, every time I see that, it just puts me in a bad mood. Hey, hey. Who do you think you are, acting all-powerful? Just a mere demon offspring. Anyway, you need to get beaten up until you're about to die.]
Fwoosh, kwaah...!
Murakan spewed black breath at the leader. The dark energy seemed to engulf the leader, but he swung his sword and easily cut through the breath.
[Murakan.]
[You're acting like you know me again, you crazy fool. Don't think about leaving nicely today.]
Jin didn't stop Murakan, who was showing off his fighting spirit. It was because he was not acting out of lost rationality, unlike when he first encountered the leader.
[Well, if you want to fight that much, there's nothing I can do.]
As Murakan charged at the leader, the battle resumed.
The battleship Grenil spread thunderclouds, and Berakt wreaked havoc with his fully recovered body.
However, even if they had shaken off their injuries, the flow of battle was bound to be similar.
After all, facing Ron and Linpa at the same time was impossible even for Berakt's martial prowess.
"White Wolf Clan... I'll... take care of it."
Ron nodded at Linpa's words, which meant to leave Berakt alone and go face the leader and the battleship Grenil.
"I'll leave it to you."
Of course, Berakt glared and swung his sword at Ron's departure, but he couldn't block it as he was pressed by Linpa's offensive.
"Little dog... I am your nemesis. Assess the situation..."
The battleship Grenil still couldn't recklessly unleash its lightning.
Jin's Extermination Dark Skyfire Pearl's ultimate form was not yet over.
Jin was still continuing his great magic on the outer wall, and the chains of fire were constricting the battleship Grenil.
'Leader Kinzelo... He's dealing with Murakan quite leisurely.'
Murakan had also used a lot of power to continue protecting the ground. However, even considering that, the leader was definitely more skilled than Murakan.
His swordsmanship, in particular, was exceptional. The leader's sword had a depth that was never inferior to any other sword Jin had ever seen.
Murakan alternated between his human transformation and his original form without a break, engaging in close combat with the leader in the air.
The leader moved as if there was ground in the air, apparently being familiar with aerial combat.
Although I felt it at that time, I wonder if it's the Murakan I knew. Why did you become so weak, friend? When I think of your majestic past, I feel like crying.
[Really? I'm weak. I admit it. Although I've regained some strength, it's still not comparable to the old days. So, I've learned something.]
Murakan surprisingly did not get angry, but seemed to accept it.
[More and more surprising. The world's Murakan learning? What is it?]
[Humans call what I've learned, "letting go of the hook," or "releasing the hook." That's how they describe it.]
Swish-!
The wind brushed past the chief's back. It was the wind containing Ron's invisible sword energy. When the invisible sword energy scraped the chief's steel bones, a piercing sound of friction echoed.
"Iron, such an unpleasant sensation."
Ron's sword swung horizontally, cutting through the chief's torso.

The steel bones were easily cut by the invisible sword energy, but it was also just as easy for them to reattach. Where ordinary humans would have flesh and muscles, the hazy area simply wavered like smoke and didn't get cut.
In other words, Ron's sword only seemed to pass through water, but the chief was not actually unharmed.
"In the end, this too is just regeneration, and it can't be infinite. Keep cutting until it can't regenerate anymore..."
Jin and Murakan had the same judgment.
Rather than the inscrutable chief, they made this judgment after seeing a change in Behrakt's behavior since the chief started wielding his power.
'Since the chief appeared and began using his power, Behrakt has rapidly become impatient. The chief's power likely requires a greater price than we can imagine.'
A price significant enough for someone like Behrakt to lose their 'composure'.
'Either the chief's own life force or something very important to Kinzelo.'
When Murakan swung his front leg and created an opening, Ron cut the chief's spine once again. His steel sword also grazed Murakan's forehead, but it wasn't a fatal wound.
On the ground, Linpa pressured Behrakt, and the other warriors escorted the wounded.
Among them, only the knights of Hairan were reorganizing their ranks, spreading out, and pouring sword energy at the Grenil warship bound by the great magic.
The situation was quickly stabilizing.
However, the problem was that Jin alone was holding the Grenil warship.
If Jin lets go of Grenil, the attack on the ground will start again, and although there would be no significant damage to the major warriors.
Ordinary people who have not yet left the battlefield and lower warriors would meet their deaths.
"Gulp...!"
Blood seeped out as he bit his lip. The magical backlash was about to begin.
'It's still okay, it's still.'

In a situation where someone else's attack is present, it would be impossible to maintain the great magic while suppressing the backlash, but for now, the situation allows him to focus entirely on the magic.
"I'm not sure if the chief's power will be exhausted first, or if my backlash will occur first. Probably the former."
Isn't it about time for them to arrive?
Jin spat blood and looked far into the sky. After all, this fight would turn into Hairan's victory the moment they arrived.
'Dragon Knights.'
In Runcandel, there were Black Knights; in Zipfel, there were White Nights and Ghost Legions; in Vermont, there were the Royal Guards and Special Forces.
And Hairan also possessed elite knights befitting one of the three great families in the world. The strongest knights of Hairan, called Dragon Knights.
Jin just had to hold on until they arrived.
Even if Jin left the battlefield right now, no one could blame him.
Jin was already making the greatest contribution in a battle he didn't have to participate in as a foreigner.
Kaaaaa...!
From beyond the dark dawn sky, a sharp cry echoed. As soon as the sound was heard, a smile crossed Jin's lips.
The faces of Ron and the other warriors were the same.
A group of dragon-like creatures, called Wyverns, approached the Black Emperor Castle like meteors.
There were thirty of them.
'It's my first time seeing them in person.'
The Dragon Knights spread out widely and surrounded the battlefield.
Although there were only thirty of them, and it seemed impossible to 'encircle' the concept, each of them was the best sword of Hairan.
The entire battlefield was instantly dyed with the murderous intent of the Dragon Knights.
"Dragon Knight Captain!"
When Ron shouted, a man riding the largest Wyvern raised his sword.
"Give us your order!"
"Half of you clean up the ground, and the other half follow me. We'll annihilate the enemies."
The Dragon Knights effortlessly split into two groups. Half descended, and half ascended, gathering around Ron and Murakan.
At that moment, Jin released the magic that was holding the Grenil warship.
The chains of fire that had been swirling around in the sky gathered into a ball of flame, and Jin pointed at the Grenil warship.
Then, once again, the black sky opened its mouth and spewed out a massive fireball. The final form of the Extermination Hellfire, the ultimate form of the Demonic Emperor.
Grenil quickly increased its power to escape the fireball, but the Dragon Knights blocked its way.
Soon after the fireball hit the hull, Grenil had to go through the ordeal of being repelled once again.
The chief was already buried under the sword energy of Ron, Murakan, and the Dragon Knights, making it impossible to even find his figure.
